headline: Costco makes big payment changes
summary: Although some people might complain about having to pay a membership fee, Costco has one of the most loyal customer bases in retail. The company reported that its U.S. and Canada membership renewal rate reached 92.2%, while the worldwide renewal rate was 89.7%, during its most recent quarter. ...
